title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode1 Weekend Plans

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was so good!
Ahh, I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, what should we do about practice this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we haven't set a meeting time yet, have we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We have the studio from two...
So, why don't we meet up a bit early and have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm sorry.
I might actually arrive late.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My neighborhood association is getting together that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your neighborhood association...?
They put on seasonal events and stuff, right? Locally organized cherry blossom viewing parties immediately come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, they also put on hiking events and fun festivals!
No fair! I wanna join!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I won't be participating in an event this time around. I'll be representing my parents at an association meeting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna be in a meeting?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, this isn't the first time you've done this for them, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I only do this on occasion. Usually during the periods when our shop is at its busiest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you get to speak for your mom and dad!
You're such a grown-up, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what are you going to discuss at this meeting?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This time, we'll be discussing a picture-book reading.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A picture-book reading...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember how you read me all those stories when we were little and I was still in the hospital, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You always put such a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I also had fun watching your eyes twinkle each time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does this mean you're gonna be the one telling stories, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, our veteran storyteller will be handling that. I'll probably be helping out behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You seem really excited about this, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? D-Do I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, the way you're smiling says it all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually attended one of these readings before when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was where I learned about this story I really love, and they're going to be telling it during this event.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So that's why you're so excited♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to this event so much.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll need to do everything I can in order to make it a great one.)
A few days later
Community Center

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Thank you all for taking time out of your busy schedules to gather here today.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: About the reading event we'll be holding next month... We've run into a slight problem, and I'd like to discuss it with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (A problem? What happened...?)

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Endo, our designated storyteller, likely won't be able to join us for this event...

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: So, we'll need to make an emergency swap.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: I'd like to begin by asking for volunteers. Would any of you care to be our storyteller?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To be the storyteller...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I did tell a few stories when I went to shadow over at that kindergarten, but this event is on a completely different scale...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually attended one of these readings before when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was where I learned about this story I really love, and they're going to be telling it during this event.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If it's alright, I'd like to volunteer!
